set.body:
Deliver complete research journeys over the existing typed foundation. This is a workstream epic and acceptance gate, not one implementation ticket.

Required scope: reproducible public/example dataset access with identity/license/hash; CSV and EyeLink ASC admission plus relevant comparator formats identified by the matrix; geometry/time configuration; meaningful data-loss/precision/quality reporting; filtering/resampling and pupil-signal blink handling; I-VT, I-DT and microsaccade routes plus the comparator's relevant additional detector coverage (including I-HMM); static AOIs and word-level reading measures; matched/control, multiscale and temporal study workflows; figures, tidy exports and saved/reloaded results. Full general pupillometry is not implied by pupil-signal blink handling. A method may be scientifically improved rather than copied, but missing capability cannot be relabeled parity.

Acceptance:
- A versioned capability matrix maps every required user task to a public entry point, executable example, scientific semantics, evidence and owning Mote. Include reading measures (first fixation, first pass/gaze duration, regressions, rereading and totals) and sample/trial/participant quality reports, not only parser validity.
- Each selected journey runs from a clean consumer installation on representative licensed/fetch-reproducible inputs. Retain exclusions, units, clocks, provenance and a checked persistence/export boundary; saved/reloaded and direct execution agree under named tolerances.
- The library workflows and one real-data Studio import/analyze/inspect/export route work through the actual backend. Distinguish desktop readiness from library availability and JVM/JS portability from a browser application.
- Close all required gaps through linked bounded implementation slices. Reuse existing eyesim baseline and Studio admission/analysis/backend work. The first matrix slice must create/link the remaining reading, QC, detector and format slices before this gate can close.

Existing core/Studio gates supply evidence but their closed statuses alone do not establish this comparative acceptance. Preserve their current scope and ownership.
set.title: PM1: complete and qualify common research workflows
